user.title: Set up Display Canvas
user.description: Choose an initial Home Assistant media folder. You can create named libraries after setup.

init.title: Configure Display Canvas
init.description: Manage image libraries and display feeds.

menu_option_descriptions.libraries: Add, update, or remove named image libraries.
menu_option_descriptions.overflight: Choose the library published to Projectivy / Overflight.
menu_option_descriptions.aerial: Choose the library published to Aerial Views.

menu_option_descriptions.save_library: Create a library or update an existing library's media folder.
menu_option_descriptions.remove_library: Remove a library that is not currently assigned to a feed.

save_library.title: Add or update library
save_library.description: Give the library a friendly name and choose its Home Assistant media folder.

data_description.library: Entering an existing name updates that library.
data_description.media_source: Browse the contents and select the folder to publish.

remove_library.title: Remove library
remove_library.description: Only libraries that are not currently assigned to a feed can be removed.

overflight.title: Projectivy / Overflight
overflight.description: Choose the named library published by the Overflight JSON feed.

aerial.title: Aerial Views
aerial.description: Choose the named library published by the Aerial Views CSV feed.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Configure fallback raw media sources. Named library assignments take precedence.

data_description.overflight_media_source: Used when Overflight does not have a valid named library assigned.
data_description.aerial_media_source: Used when Aerial Views does not have a valid named library assigned.

error.library_in_use: This library is currently assigned to a display feed. Assign another library first.
error.invalid_library_name: Library name must be between 1 and 64 characters.
error.source_not_browsable: This source is not a supported image collection. Choose a browsable media folder or a camera image source.
